units.desc: Process of opening a bank account

vids.desc: Students will learn the step-by-step process of opening a bank account through the story of Ananya. They will understand how to choose a bank, fill out an account opening form, submit important documents, complete KYC, and receive a welcome kit. This lesson also teaches students how to use decision-making skills to pick the right account type and get the correct documents ready. Through a simple activity, they will list the five steps and required documents, helping them feel confident about opening a bank account in real life.

units.desc: How to open a bank account?

vids.desc: In this activity, students will learn about how to open a bank account and the importance of saving money safely. By following simple 8 steps, they will understand how banks help us keep money secure, allow us to deposit or withdraw money, and provide useful tools like passbooks and ATM cards. Through this lesson, students will explore the difference between saving and current accounts and learn how to make responsible financial decisions with the help of their parents.

opts.2: Go to the bank and fill the form without any documents
opts.3: Wait for the bank staff to come home and open the account for her

qs.q: ATM पर एक अजनबी आपका PIN माँगता है और कहता है, "मैं आपकी मदद करूंगा।" आपको क्या करना चाहिए?

opts.1: Suggest opening a saving account and adding small amounts regularly
opts.2: Borrow from a friend
opts.3: Keep the money at home in a box without tracking it

vids.desc: Students will learn the difference between the Central Bank and Commercial Banks using simple examples like a school principal and teachers. They will understand how the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) regulates all banks, prints money, and keeps the banking system safe. Students will also explore how commercial banks help people save money and take loans. Through a creative activity, they will identify banks, draw logos, and list their functions, helping them make smart decisions about saving money.

opts.3: It might be a trick to steal your information.

opts.1: Click the link right away to claim the prize.
opts.2: Ask a trusted adult if the message is real before clicking.
opts.3: Share the message with as many friends as possible.

vids.desc: In this activity, students become Interest Investigators and help Jinal understand how money grows in a bank. Students learn the meaning of interest and explore the difference between Simple Interest and Compound Interest using formulas and real-life examples. By comparing how ₹1000 grows over time under both types of interest, students discover why compound interest earns more in the long run. Through calculation, comparison, and decision-making, students help Jinal choose the better option for growing her savings.

qs.q: बैंकिंग के संदर्भ में ब्याज की परिभाषा क्या है?

opts.1: The money you withdraw from your bank account.
opts.2: The extra money earned by keeping money in a bank account.
opts.3: The fee charged by the bank for maintaining your account.

qs.q: साधारण ब्याज और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच मुख्य अंतर क्या है?

opts.1: Simple interest is only applicable to savings accounts, while compound interest is for fixed deposits.
opts.2: Compound interest earns interest on interest, while simple interest does not.
opts.3: Simple interest is calculated annually, while compound interest is calculated monthly.

qs.q: साधारण ब्याज फॉर्मूले का उपयोग करके, ₹1000 पर 10% दर से एक वर्ष में कितना ब्याज मिलेगा?

opts.1: Rs 100
opts.2: Rs 100
opts.3: Rs 10

qs.q: जिनल तीन वर्षों में अपनी कमाई को अधिकतम करना चाहती है। दिए गए उदाहरण के आधार पर उसे किस प्रकार का ब्याज चुनना चाहिए?

opts.1: Simple interest
opts.2: No interest
opts.3: Compound interest

qs.q: यदि जिनल को एक वर्ष के अल्पकालिक निवेश के लिए साधारण और चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच चुनाव करना है, तो स्क्रिप्ट के अनुसार कौन सा अधिक फायदेमंद है?

opts.1: Neither, both provide the same interest for one year.
opts.2: Compound interest because it accumulates more over time.
opts.3: Simple interest because it is easier to calculate.
